summary: P2 delivers its outcome: a committed dist/ store, a full-directory helm repo index with absolute https://charts.home URLs, an nginx:alpine image baking both, and a Jenkinsfile pushing :<build>+:latest through helmCharts.kaniko2 then triggering IaC/HelmCharts. Verified beyond the gate by running the uncovered `kc project build` (green) and by two mutation probes. Three Minor advisory findings, none blocking: the base image's stock index.html/50x.html survive into the served root (so `/` is not the 404 P3's plan text assumed — plan.md corrected), the gate lets an already-published tarball be silently rewritten, and tools/package-chart.sh is never executed by anything.
